name: (Special Forces) Punitive Attack
text:
Trigger An enemy within 5 feet of the special forces unit uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using

---
Effect The special forces troops swing their weapons. The triggering enemy takes 5d6+10 slashing damage (DC 34 basic Reflex save save). If the creature critically fails its saving throw and the trigger was a manipulate action, the troop disrupts that action.
